### OpenAI discounts to poach Anthropic customers
OpenAI is offering discounts of up to 90 percent to companies like Rippling and Replit to poach them from Anthropic. This competitive move occurs as Anthropic co-founder Jack Clark moves his prediction for self-improving AI forward to 2027. ([THE DECODER](https://the-decoder.com/openai-offers-discounts-up-to-90-percent-to-poach-anthropics-biggest-customers/), [THE DECODER](https://the-decoder.com/anthropic-co-founder-jack-clark-moves-his-prediction-for-self-improving-ai-forward-to-2027/))

### Kimi K3.1 Pro launch and influencer promotion scrutiny
Moonshot AI's Kimi K3.1 Pro model debut has drawn scrutiny over allegations that influencers were asked to promote it without disclosing a commercial relationship. The model is also being compared to Claude Opus 5.5 in agentic coding tasks and discussed in recent AI news podcasts. ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261025/p2#a261025p2), [Interconnects](https://www.interconnects.ai/p/podcast-kimi-k31-pro-the-new-cyber), [Prompt Engineering](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_XXX5K-EMoc))

### Anthropic sued over Elvis Presley music usage
Authentic Brands Group has sued Anthropic, alleging the company infringed on the rights of 274 Elvis Presley songs by using them to train its AI models. ([Hacker News (AI tag)](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/music/music-industry-news/anthropic-elvis-presley-lawsuit-ai-1236739617/), [Artificial intelligence (AI)](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/oct/25/elvis-presley-anthropic-lawsuit-ai-models-music))

### Apollo economist says AI yields zero payoff outside tech
An Apollo economist stated that artificial intelligence has provided zero financial payoff to most companies outside the technology sector, despite significant investment. ([Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-25/ai-provides-zero-payoff-to-s-p-493-outside-tech-apollo-economist-says), [Business Insider](https://www.businessinsider.com/apollo-ai-zero-financial-payoff-corporate-america-economic-analysis-2026-10), [Hacker News (AI tag)](https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/25/ai-delivers-zero-financial-payoff-to-most-companies-according-to-apollo-economist/))

### PyTorch Conference 2026: Google and Meta Open-Source TorchTPU for Native PyTorch on TPUs
Google and Meta open-sourced TorchTPU, a native PyTorch backend for Google's TPUs, at PyTorch Conference North America 2026, and Meta said it plans to move larger LLM workloads onto TPUs with it. AWS released TorchNeuron for Trainium the same week, while developers questioned TPU availability and w… ([InfoQ](https://www.infoq.com/news/2026/10/google-meta-torchtpu/?utm_campaign=infoq_content&utm_source=infoq&utm_medium=feed&utm_term=AI%2C+ML+%26+Data+Engineering))

### Bill Gates warns of AI's impact on workers
Bill Gates warned that the evolutionary age of AI will be brutal for workers and predicted 20 years of turmoil before the technology creates true abundance. ([Business Insider](https://www.businessinsider.com/bill-gates-ai-abundance-job-losses-unemployment-robots-musk-amodei-2026-10), [Hacker News (AI tag)](https://observer.co.uk/news/technology/article/bill-gates-warns-the-evolutionary-age-of-ai-will-be-brutal-for-workers))

### Jensen Huang’s Keynote Highlights at NVIDIA GTC Berlin 2026
Europe is building its AI economy. NVIDIA founder and CEO Jensen Huang explains how AI factories are evolving to run agents and why physical AI is the next frontier. ([NVIDIA](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rF1EsryCAwc))

### Ray-Ban Meta Audio AI glasses review
Bloomberg Technology reviewed the new Ray-Ban Meta Audio AI glasses, noting they cost more than previous models while dropping a key feature. The device is also highlighted in a roundup of the hottest AI wearables and gadgets. ([Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-25/ray-ban-meta-audio-ai-glasses-cost-more-while-ditching-a-key-feature-review), [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/25/the-hottest-ai-wearables-and-gadgets-you-should-know-about/))
